name: Flourished Peony
description: He Weifang, the daughter of a merchant, partners with the infamous Jiang Changyang to run a flower business, empowering women and challenging societal norms. As their bond deepens, He Weifang uncovers Jiang Changyang's true identity and is inspired to focus on ventures that benefit the greater good.

videos.title: A Marriage of Convenience
videos.overview: He Wei Fang agrees to marry Liu Chang to save her mother, but her life after marriage has been tough. Despite the hardships, she remains composed and patient. One day, the Liu family goes behind her back and digs up the prized peonies in her courtyard for a flower banquet. Distraught, she resolves to protect the keepsakes left by her mother.

videos.title: Flower Banquet
videos.overview: Jiang Chang Yang and the County Princess attend the Yang family's flower banquet. The County Princess keeps making life difficult for He Wei Fang.

videos.title: A Certain Divorce
videos.overview: Liu Shen finds out that He Wei Fang is visiting the shops. He's afraid that she might foil his plan of selling the shops. He goes to stop her. During the chaos, Yu Lu, her servant, falls into the water while trying to defend her mistress. He Wei Fang kneels and begs the Liu family to rescue her.

videos.title: Rekindling Old Flames
videos.overview: Jiang Chang Yang pledges his support to the County Princess and helps her arrange a private meeting with Liu Chang. At the Shuiyu Pavilion, the County Princess and Liu Chang reminisce about their past relationship, while He Wei Fang begins to execute her plans.

videos.title: Leaving the Liu Residence
videos.overview: Liu Chang barges into He Wei Fang's room after getting drunk. He intends to force himself upon her. He Wei Fang is hurt during the struggle. After that, He Wei Fang injures herself with a pair of scissors on purpose as she seeks Jiang Chang Yang's aid.

videos.title: Starting Anew
videos.overview: Realizing she no longer has a home, He Wei Fang deliberately leaves her hairpin at the edge of a cliff. Liu Shen's men find the hairpin and conclude she has fallen to her death. Afterward, He Wei Fang puts on plain clothes and sets out to begin a new chapter of her life.

videos.title: Forced Fate
videos.overview: After many days of inquiry, He Wei Fang finds out that Wanguan Hall is able to help people handle household registers...

videos.title: Business Opportunity
videos.overview: It's difficult to make a living in Chang'an. He Wei Fang decides to start a business with her gardening skills.

videos.title: Marriage
videos.overview: Li You Zhen stops her father, King Ning, from betrothing her to Jiang Chang Yang. She kneels and begs for his forgiveness.

videos.title: Sincerity
videos.overview: He Wei Fang arrives at the Jiang's Residence to care for the Jade Orchid and happens to witness the grand ceremony of opening the warehouse. She is astonished by Jiang Chang Yang's extravagant style of receiving gifts.

videos.title: Relentless Pester
videos.overview: When Sheng Yi is busy at the flower stall, her ex-husband Wang Qing suddenly shows up and relentlessly pesters her.

videos.title: Swearing An Oath
videos.overview: Da Fu chases away the troublemakers with her excellent martial arts. Both He Wei Fang and Sheng Yi like Da Fu's straightforward personality.

videos.title: Keeping A Secret
videos.overview: He Wei Fang leaves the city to harvest peonies. She witnesses Jiang Chang Yang murdering Imperial Academy's Xu Zu Ping by accident.

videos.title: Self-sufficient
videos.overview: He Wei Fang rejects the Flower Association leader's suggestion of an even profit split so the Flower Association bans them from purchasing fertilizers. Sheng Yi suggests apologizing to the association, but He Wei Fang decides to make her own fertilizer instead.

videos.title: Their Wager
videos.overview: Jiang Chang Yang confides in He Wei Fang, sharing his feelings about his father's betrayal and his aversion to marriage. They wager on who will break their vow and get married first.

videos.title: Dangerous Encounters
videos.overview: Chuan Yu invites He Wei Fang to the Jiang Residence and claims Jiang Chang Yang wants to discuss his aunt with her. However, he locks Mu Dan inside a pitch-black room.

videos.title: Life and Death
videos.overview: He Wei Fang is pursued by a masked assassin in the wilderness. He Wei Fang shouts for help, but she fails to escape from the assassin. The assassin raises the blade in his hand and prepares to stab He Wei Fang.

videos.title: The Mastermind
videos.overview: The flowers in the shop are infested with pests. Upon investigation, Mu Dan discovers that someone has planted insect eggs into the fertilizer.

videos.title: Being Independent
videos.overview: Sheng Yi is persuaded by Wang Qing. She thinks that women should live their lives with a mate. He Wei Fang persuades Sheng Yi patiently. She tells her that being independent is more important than getting married.

videos.title: Cancelling the Marriage
videos.overview: Liu Chang asks King Ning to cancel his marriage with Li You Zhen. He thinks it's unfair to marry her if he cannot love her wholeheartedly. Because of that, he is willing to resign as the assistant minister of the Ministry of Revenue.

videos.title: Identity Exposed
videos.overview: Li You Zhen learns that Liu Chang has been frequenting a tavern, and directly across the street is Blooming Abode, which turns out to be He Wei Fang's business. Li You Zhen confronts the Liu family and demands that Liu Shen report He Wei Fang's true identity to the authorities.

videos.title: Senteced to Slavery
videos.overview: He Wei Fang is sentenced to serve as a government slave in the military. The camp's commanding officer uses the slaves as live targets to train the recruits in archery.

videos.title: Reunion
videos.overview: Sheng Yi returns to the temple ruins where she started the business with Mu Dan and prays for the deity to let Mu Dan return safely. Mu Dan appears and questions Sheng Yi as to why she betrayed her.

videos.title: Getting Back Blooming Abode
videos.overview: Wang Qing kneels and begs Mu Dan for help. Mu Dan agrees to help him with the condition that he returns Blooming Abode to her and apologizes to Sheng Yi.

videos.title: Joining Hands
videos.overview: Jiang Chang Yang reminds He Wei Fang that behind the moldy grain issue in the West Market lies an intricate and complex network. He Wei Fang understands what Jiang Chang Yang is implying. She understands that he's making preparations to topple the corrupt officials. They decide to join hands.

videos.title: Opening of the Branch
videos.overview: Blooming Abode's branch is officially opened in the Eastern market. He Wei Fang and Da Fu dress up to welcome their customers.

videos.title: The Attempted Assassination on Jiang Chang Yang
videos.overview: He Wei Fang and Geng Chun bump into four young men acting suspiciously at Huanyun Pavilion. Wei Fang senses that the scrolls they carry might be concealing weapons. Meanwhile, Jiang Chang Yang is in a secret meeting with the Emperor inside the pavilion.

videos.title: Wedding Preparation
videos.overview: King Ning orders Jiang Chang Yang to hand over He Wei Fang. As the situation is dire, Jiang Chang Yang tells King Ning that he is preparing to take He Wei Fang as his concubine.

videos.title: Recovering Fang Garden
videos.overview: Liu Chang will marry the county princess soon. Leader Lv and his flower association have taken up the important task of preparing fresh flowers for the occasion. Leader Lv seeks help from He Wei Fang.

videos.title: Married
videos.overview: Jiang Chang Yang and Mu Dan complete their wedding according to the customs under Dean Xu's supervision to become a married couple.

videos.title: Taking A Concubine
videos.overview: Jiang Chang Yang is forced by King Ning to marry Lian Zhou as his concubine. After the wedding banquet, he hides in He Wei Fang's room. They wait for Lian Zhou to come over so they can put on a planned show to fool her.

videos.title: Opening of Fang Garden
videos.overview: He Wei Fang finds Liu Lang, Sheng Yi's younger brother, at the corner of the street. Liu Lang is coughing and has shortness of breath. He Wei Fang decides to take him back to Fang Garden to seek treatment.

videos.title: Jealousy
videos.overview: Consumed by jealousy over He Wei Fang's exclusive favor, Lian Zhou tries to convince Da Fu to falsely accuse He Wei Fang of stealing her jewelry.

videos.title: Shut Down Qingshu Pavilion
videos.overview: Liu Chang meets with He Wei Fang, which makes the Princess seethe with jealousy. She arranges for someone to slander He Wei Fang, accusing her that the Tresses Pill in her shop has killed Madam Wu.

videos.title: Conspiracy
videos.overview: He Wei Fang senses that Zhao Cai and Lian Zhou are plotting something. Thus, she tails Lian Zhou. She finds out why she approached Jiang Chang Yang.

videos.title: Xiao Xue Xi's Visit
videos.overview: Xiao Xue Xi, the daughter of General Xiao, the Governor of Hexi, arrives in the capital. King Ning plans to arrange a marriage between her and Pei Zhong, a descendant of a noble family. Though Pei Zhong is deeply taken with Xue Xi, he fears she has feelings for her childhood friend, Jiang Chang Yang. This leads him to come up with a devious plan.

videos.title: Searching Wanguan Hall
videos.overview: Liu Chang orders his men to search Wanguan Hall when Jiang Chang Yang is being imprisoned. He Wei Fang asks Da Fu to inform Miss Yun while she attempts to slow Liu Chang down.

videos.title: Fire at the Fang Garden
videos.overview: The Fang Garden catches on fire. Mu Dan rushes in with no regard for her own safety to save the people inside. When Jiang Chang Yang finds out, he runs into the fire to look for He Wei Fang. But he passes out from inhaling too much smoke.

videos.title: Confession
videos.overview: Jiang Chang Yang spends Xue Xi's birthday with her. Fueled by a bit of Dutch courage, Xue Xi confesses her feelings for Jiang Chang Yang.

videos.title: Admission of Arson
videos.overview: The pirate points out in court that he was instructed by Princess Li You Zhen. Li You Zhen worries that it will affect King Ning if things get out of hand. Thus, she admits that she's the culprit behind the fire.

videos.title: Secret Chamber
videos.overview: King Ning orders Liu Chang to conduct a surprise raid on Jiang Chang Yang's residence, where they uncover a hidden chamber.

videos.title: Peerless Youthful Beauty
videos.overview: Foreign envoys and officials gather at the Imperial Garden to admire the blooming snow peonies. Everyone has high praise for the view. The emperor is delighted. He grants He Wei Fang a plaque with the writing "Peerless Youthful Beauty" on it.

videos.title: Kidnapping
videos.overview: Pei Zhong blames Jiang Chang Yang for ruining his plans with Xue Xi, so he kidnaps He Wei Fang to get back at him. As soon as Jiang Chang Yang finds out, he immediately gathers his men to confront Pei Zhong.

videos.title: Search of the Merchant Ship
videos.overview: Jiang Chang Yang informs Vice Minister Lu to search the merchant ship escorted by Liu Chang. The search uncovers a large number of Buddha statues forged from copper and iron. When questioned by the Emperor, King Ning, trying to cover up his secret weapon production, claims that Liu Chang will be stripped of his rank.

videos.title: Death of Her Mother
videos.overview: He Wei Fang finds out that there might be more to her mother's death than meets the eye. Thus, she investigates the background of Mr. Wu.

videos.title: Robbed
videos.overview: He Wei Fang, Xiao Chun, and Da Fu are making a delivery for their customer and encounter bandits along the way. After receiving news from Liu Lang, Jiang Chang Yang rushes to save them.

videos.title: Saving Lives, Serving the Nation
videos.overview: He Wei Fang reopens Fang Garden and establishes Wuyong Clinic, making it easier for the poor to seek medical treatment.

videos.title: Stripped of His Position
videos.overview: The emperor is mad at Jiang Chang Yang for taking bribes. He strips him of his position as Flower Bird Envoy. At the same time, he seizes all of his assets.

videos.title: Divorce Letter
videos.overview: Jiang Chang Yang is worried that his plan will bring Mu Dan harm so he gives her the divorce letter.

videos.title: Spring Imperial Exam
videos.overview: The spring imperial exam is nearing. King Ning and his faction cut the lamp oil supply to interrupt modest scholars from studying for the exam. He Wei Fang teaches them how to create lamp oil and thinks of a way to transport a large amount of it into the Capital.

videos.title: The Condemnation of King Ning
videos.overview: Upon learning of Jiang Chang Yang's plan, He Wei Fang suggests hosting the banquet at Fang Garden to facilitate their scheme. During the banquet, Zhang Qian leads the newly appointed young officials in reciting a poem condemning corrupt officials, a pointed critique aimed squarely at King Ning.

videos.title: Trapped in Liu Residence
videos.overview: Jiang Chang Yang is killed by King Ning. He Wei Fang is knocked out by Liu Chang and brought back to his residence. When she wakes up, she finds out she is tied to a bed in handcuffs and shackles.

videos.title: Escaping Liu Residence
videos.overview: Li You Zhen releases He Wei Fang. He Wei Fang escapes to Huanyun Pavilion. She puts up the secret signal previously agreed upon with Jiang Chang Yang.

videos.title: Reunited
videos.overview: Magistrate Du hires some people to take revenge on He Wei Fang. He Wei Fang hides in an umbrella workshop. Someone suddenly appears during the crisis and knocks out everyone who tries to capture He Wei Fang.

videos.title: Clash of Armies
videos.overview: The Hedong army's granaries and supplies are burned to ashes by King Ning's men. Upon learning that Jiang Chang Yang's forces are running low on provisions at the frontlines, He Wei Fang organizes the collection of military supplies and delivers them to the battlefield via large merchant ships.

videos.title: Traveling South
videos.overview: He Wei Fang and Jiang Chang Yang plan to travel south to do business. They reluctantly bid farewell to everyone from Fang Garden.
